cv:
Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
Data Scientist

Edinburgh, UK - tobias.mwangihartley@example.com - +44 7700 900110 - linkedin.com/in/tmh-example

Profile
Data scientist with 6 years in analytics and data science (4+ as data scientist), focused on experimentation, forecasting and customer analytics for a subscription business. Strong in statistics and in translating business questions into analyses that people act on. Now moving towards machine learning engineering.

Experience

Data Scientist, Thistlebox (meal-kit subscriptions), Edinburgh - Feb 2022 to present
- Design and analyse A/B tests for the growth and product teams (~40 experiments per year); built the team's sequential testing calculator.
- Built the weekly demand forecasting model per recipe (LightGBM + calendar features), used by operations to order ingredients; forecast error (WAPE) reduced from 23% to 14%, food waste down an estimated 9%.
- Churn propensity model (XGBoost) used to target retention offers; uplift validated with a holdout.
- Write production SQL in BigQuery and maintain dbt models for the analytics layer.
- Present results to leadership monthly.

Junior Data Analyst, Firth Energy Retail, Glasgow - Sep 2020 to Jan 2022
- Customer segmentation and tariff analysis in R and SQL.
- Automated monthly regulator reports with R Markdown.

Education
MSc Statistics, University of the Lothians, 2020 (Distinction)
Dissertation: Bayesian hierarchical models for small-area energy demand
BSc Mathematics, University of the Lothians, 2019

Skills
Python (pandas, scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, statsmodels), R (tidyverse, brms), SQL (BigQuery), dbt, Git, Jupyter, Looker, A/B testing, causal inference, time-series forecasting, Bayesian statistics

Languages
English (native), Swahili (conversational)
cover_letter:
Dear Thistlebox Data Team,

I am applying for the Data Scientist role.

At Firth Energy Retail I work as a junior data analyst, where I segment customers and analyse tariffs in R and SQL. I automated our monthly regulator reports with R Markdown, which saved the team about two days each month.

My MSc in Statistics, with a dissertation on Bayesian hierarchical models, gave me a strong foundation in experimental design and modelling uncertainty. I would love to apply this to a fast-moving consumer business where experiments drive decisions every week.

I have been learning Python to complement R, and I am comfortable with pandas and scikit-learn.

Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
